description: "Which charging alerts do I have?": the alerts the signed-in driver set up on ChargingNear.me: stations watched for a free charger, price alerts on stations and saved trips, network status alerts and alert areas, each with what triggers it, whether it is on and when it last sent. Needs the driver to sign in to ChargingNear.me; without sign-in it answers with a short message and the sign-in page link.
name: get_my_alerts
title: My alerts
